title: PHONETIC requires a reference operand at entry and returns #N/A under non-Japanese profiles
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527 (en-ZA), PHONETIC(reference) accepts only an operand that can yield a reference at formula entry (=PHONETIC(2), =PHONETIC({1,2}), and =PHONETIC(1+1) are refused with 0x800A03EC, while =PHONETIC(B1) and =PHONETIC(INDEX(B1:B3,0)) enter), and returns #N/A for both text and blank cells under non-Japanese editing profiles. Matches 3,056/3,056 full-bank rows under en-ZA.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata (row 305), 8 entry probes in excel-entry.tsv, and 3,056/3,056 full-bank PHONETIC rows.

repros.recorded_in: Excel 16.0.20527.20088 Current Channel, Windows 64-bit (NT 10.0.26200), x86-64, AMD Ryzen 7 4800H, en-ZA

evidence.note: PHONETIC #N/A under non-Japanese profiles and reference-only entry rule
